data.long_meaning: Derived from the Turkish word 'meral', which means 'bright', 'clear', or 'shining'. The name reflects the inner light and radiance of the person bearing it. Parents who choose Meral usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
